g.title: OX99ParkBehavior
g.text: OX-99 — Park-specific three-plane artwork integration | OWNER REVIEW DRAFT • NOT APPROVED

g.title: owner
g.text: Owner decision · 2026-11-24
Keep OX-99/OX-102 gated pending completed and approved boards.
Owns the three supplied PNGs and authorized review-board reproduction,
asset derivation, in-app display, and distribution. Preserve bytes/alpha.
Creator/source and separate terms remain unspecified.

g.title: reference
g.text: Available owner-designated Concept 01 placement mockup
Tower = location; mural = current temperature/condition + owner-directed wind chill;
banner = wind; separate board = daily date/HI/LO/precipitation; bottom strip = daily cards.
OX-41 sample values are illustrative. Exact source-layer registration is not measured.

g.title: allocation
g.text: Later owner choice: Streetcar Stop allocation
Shelter = hourly NEXT HOURS; separate board retains daily date/HI/LO/precipitation.
This supersedes the earlier three-day HI/LO shelter assignment.
The mockup depicts three sample rows; exact hourly count/range remains open.

g.title: scope
g.text: Scope and architecture boundary
Existing app
Living Urban Park currently draws nine elements across BACKGROUND, MURAL_WALL, PARK_LANDMARKS, PATH, FOREGROUND.
Center reading, selected time, forecast truth, support/uncertainty and unavailable meaning remain app-owned.
OX-99
Park-specific wiring on the current Compose Canvas using approved images and OX-101 contract.
No shared image compositor implementation, pack-manifest change, or general renderer scope.
Specify and verify reusable plane/layer ordering.
Does not itself establish universal plane bases or implement a shared compositor.
Source gap
Three supplied transparent PNGs contain no streetcar shelter.
Current app has a procedural shelter but no forecast sign/rows; source/disposition and sign treatment remain open.

g.title: readings
g.text: Live reading surfaces · roles selected, exact placement/order remains open
Surface
Selected role / current behavior
Remaining decision
Tower
Location appears at the tower in Concept 01.
Exact live text anchor and image-plane order.
Mural
Current temperature, wind chill, condition icon. Current MURAL code renders temperature/source-time or unavailable.
Text layout, disclosure location, center-reading order, unavailable layout.
Banner
Wind appears on the banner; background source banner is blank.
Exact live wind content/anchor and image-plane order.
Shelter
Hourly NEXT HOURS; mockup has three example rows.
Physical shelter source/disposition, sign, exact hourly range/count and selected-time behavior.
Separate board
Daily date, HI/LO, precipitation chance, shown on foreground blank board in Concept 01.
Exact text bounds/order and unavailable behavior; no mock value becomes forecast truth.
Bottom strip / center reading
Daily forecast cards / full app-owned readout overlay.
Preserve timeline semantics; specify exact overlay order and no duplicate or hidden essential facts.

g.title: states
g.text: Fixed-art behavior across selected-time states · owner decision required
State
Source observation
Owner choice
Daylight / supported value
Art is sunlit; values are not baked into the transparent PNGs.
Show supplied art / suppress? Alternate art is separate scope.
Night / supported value
Art remains sunlit and lamps are lit.
Show supplied art / suppress? Alternate art is separate scope.
Supported rain
Art has wet-looking paving/water; shared renderer draws supported rain.
Keep with rain / suppress? Alternate art is separate scope.
Supported snow
Art has no visible snow; shared renderer draws supported snow.
Keep with snow / suppress? Alternate art is separate scope.
Selected value unavailable
Images have no forecast text; current app surfaces show unavailable.
Approve visible reading surface and image fallback together.
Invariant:
app owns selected time, forecast facts/support, uncertainty, weather decisions, and unavailable meaning.

g.title: gate
g.text: Before OX-102 asset preparation or OX-99 integration:
complete the plane/disposition rows; resolve shelter art/sign and hourly range;
set exact reading anchors/order and fixed-art state policy; revise and obtain approval.
